verified_claims.text: 目前評估聚焦於兩個各約一百萬 token 的語料庫及其特定 sensemaking 問題，仍需研究其表現能否泛化至不同領域與用途的資料集。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
Our evaluation to date has focused on sensemaking questions specific to two corpora each containing
approximately 1 million tokens. More work is needed to understand how performance generalizes to
datasets from various domains with different use cases.

verified_claims.text: 作者認為，採用 SelfCheckGPT 等方法比較 fabrication rates，可強化現有分析。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
Comparison of fabrication rates, e.g., using
approaches like SelfCheckGPT (Manakul et al., 2023), would also strengthen the current analysis.

verified_claims.text: 現有 GraphRAG 所依賴的圖索引、豐富文本註釋與階層式社群結構，為進一步改良與調適提供多種可能。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
The graph index, rich text annotations, and hierarchical community structure supporting the current
GraphRAG approach offer many possibilities for refinement and adaptation.

verified_claims.text: 作者提出更局部式的 RAG：以 embedding 匹配使用者查詢與圖註釋；也看好先結合 embedding 匹配與即時社群報告生成，再採用 map-reduce 摘要的混合式方案。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
This includes RAG
approaches that operate in a more local manner, via embedding-based matching of user queries and
graph annotations. In particular, we see potential in hybrid RAG schemes that combine embedding-
based matching with just-in-time community report generation before employing our map-reduce
summarization mechanisms.

verified_claims.text: roll-up 方法可跨社群階層的多個層級延伸，也可實作為 drill-down 機制，沿高層社群摘要所含的資訊線索向下探索。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
This “roll-up” approach could also be extended across multiple levels
of the community hierarchy, as well as implemented as a more exploratory “drill down” mechanism
that follows the information scent contained in higher-level community summaries.

verified_claims.text: 若生成回答未準確呈現來源資料，大型文件集合問答可能對下游 sensemaking 與決策任務造成風險。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
As a mechanism for question answering over large document collections, there
are risks to downstream sensemaking and decision-making tasks if the generated answers do not
accurately represent the source data.

verified_claims.text: 系統使用時應清楚揭露 AI 的使用及輸出可能出錯。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
System use should be accompanied by clear disclosures of AI
use and the potential for errors in outputs.

verified_claims.text: 作者認為，針對全局性問題，GraphRAG 相較向量 RAG 顯示出降低下游風險的潛力，因為後者可能把檢索到的事實樣本錯誤呈現為全局摘要。
verified_claims.evidence_text:
Compared to vector RAG, however, GraphRAG shows
promise as a way to mitigate these downstream risks for questions of a global nature, which might
otherwise be answered by samples of retrieved facts falsely presented as global summaries.
